from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd()

jobs=list(csv.DictReader(text.splitlines(),delimiter="|"))
if len(jobs)!=1 or jobs[0]!=dict(JobID="24223",State="COMPLETED",ExitCode="0:0",AllocCPUS="4"): raise ValueError("Matched diagnostic not successfully terminal")

 query,indices=h.subset_species(loaded[case["query_species"]],32);target=loaded[case["target_species"]]

 rows.append({"query":case["query_species"],"target":case["target_species"],"cap":case["candidate_cap"],"candidate_count":actual["candidate_count"],"significant_hits":case["runs"][0]["significant_hits"],"fingerprint":actual,"viterbi_fraction_of_instrumented_wall":viterbi/cost["wall_s"],"profile_build_fraction_of_instrumented_wall":stages["build_profiles_batch"]["wall_s"]/cost["wall_s"]})
